summary.headline: NSE Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT rose 23% YoY to ₹2,578 crore on revenue from operations up 11% to ₹4,067 crore.
summary.overview: Consolidated total income rose 9% YoY to ₹4,554 crore in Q2 FY27, with revenue from operations up 11% to ₹4,067 crore. Profit before tax from continuing operations rose 13% YoY to ₹3,425 crore, or 9% when normalised for one-offs in the prior-year quarter. Q2 FY26 expenses included a ₹1,297 crore SEBI settlement provision, so reported expenditure fell 51% YoY; excluding it, expenditure rose 10%. This was the company's first earnings call after listing.

financial_highlights.metric: Profit before tax from continuing operations (Q2 FY27)

segments.name: Transaction charges
segments.commentary: Q2 FY27 transaction charges rose 9% YoY to ₹3,035 crore, about 75% of operating revenue. Options contributed ₹2,216 crore (+6%), of which Nifty weekly expiry was ₹1,699 crore (38% of total income); cash market ₹474 crore (+30%); equity futures ₹328 crore.

segments.name: Listing services
segments.commentary: Revenue rose 70% YoY to ₹150 crore on 62 mainboard listings and larger issue sizes; total equity raised in the quarter was ₹2.4 lakh crore (+111% YoY).

segments.name: Data-related services
segments.commentary: Revenue rose 8% YoY to ₹531 crore, about 13% of operating income, covering data centre rack charges, connectivity, data feed and terminal services and licensing.

segments.name: Mutual funds (transaction charges)
segments.commentary: Grew 3.5x YoY to ₹13 crore from ₹4 crore; MF orders rose 155% YoY to 6.72 crore with NSE market share near 22%.

segments.name: NSE Clearing (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 total income ₹1,152 crore (+16% YoY); profit after tax ₹597 crore (+11% YoY).

segments.name: NSE Data & Analytics (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 total income ₹278 crore (+45% YoY); profit after tax ₹123 crore (+61% YoY).

segments.name: NSE Indices (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 total income ₹104 crore (+10% YoY); profit after tax ₹63 crore (+9% YoY).

segments.name: NSEIX (GIFT City subsidiary)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 total income ₹79 crore (+17% YoY); profit after tax ₹15 crore, up 4.3x.

guidance_outlook: Management does not usually give guidance; H2 FY27 capex expected in line with H1, around ₹450 crore.
Employee cost growth (18% YoY in Q2, 21% in H1) expected to moderate once the wage code impact is in the year-ago base.
Technology spend seen at about 8.7% of operating revenue, with growth in the mid-teens.
Cash market activity expected to expand after CAS amendments go live in December 2026; market participants have about one year before further expiry-related changes.
Corporate Bond Index futures await RBI approval after SEBI NOC; more EGR collection centres and products to be announced in coming months.
capex_capacity: H1 FY27 capex about ₹490 crore including roughly ₹50 crore for co-location rack expansion, which management called episodic.

Co-location: about 1,868 total racks after adding close to 800 full rack equivalents since January 2025; surplus rack capacity currently; around 300 members use colo; colo infrastructure upgrade under consideration.
Core settlement guarantee fund ₹13,665 crore; Investor Protection Fund corpus ₹2,973 crore; risk reserves ₹4,805 crore (as of September 2026).
Net worth ₹28,907 crore at 30 September 2026; total treasury investments ₹52,613 crore, of which corporate treasury ₹34,699 crore; H1 ROE 19% non-annualised.
demand_pricing: Equity cash market ADT rose 23.7% YoY to ₹1.18 lakh crore in Q2 FY27 but fell about 13% QoQ from ₹1.36 lakh crore in Q1, per management's figures.
Equity futures ADT fell 11.7% YoY to ₹1.25 lakh crore, partly due to changes in taxation; equity options premium ADT rose 3.3% YoY.
NSE market share: about 92% cash, 99.8% equity futures, 68.0% equity options (premium); management says normalised options share is near 70%, and weekly index options share has stabilised at 70-72%.
Commodity options premium turnover reached ₹296.8 crore per day in Q2 (+116% QoQ, 8x YoY); crude oil expiry revision drove growth. Monthly electricity futures have about 64% share.
Debt: EBP primary bond issuance ₹1.30 lakh crore across 76 issuers in Q2; tri-party repo ADT ₹6,825 crore (+152.8% YoY); RFQ ADT ₹6,508 crore (+10% YoY).
Pricing lever: a Market LENS data suite is free for now against an estimated ₹6,000-10,000 per year for comparable market offerings; management flagged a possible small fee later.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook post the CAS changes and how has the RBI bank guarantee rule affected volumes?
qa_highlights.answer: Cash ADT fell 13% QoQ but rose 24% YoY; management sees CAS impact mainly on expiry settlement pricing. The bank guarantee rule went live 1 July after a three-month extension, and management said no clear specific impact can be isolated.

qa_highlights.question: How should co-location revenue evolve?
qa_highlights.answer: Rack count is 1,868 after about 800 added since January 2025, with surplus capacity and about 300 members using colo. Management pointed to transaction charges as well as rental income.

qa_highlights.question: How will the commodity volume surge be sustained and extended to other commodities?
qa_highlights.answer: Crude oil options premium rose from about ₹880 crore in January 2026 to about ₹8,200 crore in October 2026, with the expiry revision and member connectivity as drivers. Co-location is not yet allowed in commodities.

qa_highlights.question: Will weekly expiry changes affect options revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give the expiry-specific revenue share and will share it offline; it cited the SEBI chairperson's statements that no move to fortnightly or monthly expiry is planned.

qa_highlights.question: What are the employee and technology cost trends?
qa_highlights.answer: Employee costs rose 18% YoY in Q2 and 21% in H1 and are expected to moderate; technology should be about 8.7% of operating revenue and grow in the mid-teens.

qa_highlights.question: What is the capex outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: H2 FY27 capex is expected to be in line with H1 at about ₹450 crore, with co-location expansion adding episodic spend.

risks_watch: Equity futures ADT fell 11.7% YoY, and management attributed part of this to tax changes; watch for further F&O volume pressure.
Regulatory changes: the CAS amendments go live in December 2026, and SEBI's EPI margin easing and SLB reforms could alter cash and clearing dynamics.
Weekly index options (Nifty weekly ₹1,699 crore in Q2, 38% of total income) are the most concentrated revenue line; expiry-related revenue sensitivity is not yet quantified.
Employee and technology cost growth remains elevated; the moderation in employee cost growth has not yet been shown in numbers.
Corporate Bond Index futures and EGR expansion depend on pending RBI approval and launch timing; revenue recognition timing is unclear.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and market-share stability, with management repeatedly deflecting specific quantification (bank guarantee impact, expiry-linked revenue) to offline follow-ups. Cautious on near-term cash volumes, which management tied to geopolitics and pending regulatory changes.
key_quotes: So, the cash market and the implementation of the closing auction session have both performed in an expected way.
We have a surplus rack situation right now and we have also enough capacity and space to expand the number of racks in quick time if need be.
So we don't typically give guidance, Madhukar, but I think you can estimate that the second half will probably be in line with the first half.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning

rows.label: Volume growth

rows.label: New capex announcement

rows.label: Guidance upgrade

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Cash volumes fell ~13% QoQ and equity futures ADT fell 11.7% YoY partly on tax changes, and the CAS and bank guarantee rule effects are not quantified, while Nifty weekly options are 38% of total income.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Corporate Bond Index futures await RBI approval after SEBI NOC, and more EGR collection centres and products are to be announced in coming months, with timing dependent on RBI.

rows.label: Market LENS data suite fee

rows.label: Cash market recovery after CAS amendments
rows.why: Management expects cash market activity to expand after CAS goes live in December 2026, but cash ADT already fell ~13% QoQ to ₹1.18 lakh crore and management was cautious on near-term volumes.

rows.label: Commodity options expansion
rows.why: Commodity options premium reached ₹296.8 crore/day in Q2 (+116% QoQ, 8x YoY), with crude oil premium rising from about ₹880 crore in January 2026 to about ₹8,200 crore in October 2026, though co-location is not yet allowed in commodities.

tone.note: Management was confident on growth, market-share stability and commodity momentum but cautious on near-term cash volumes, and repeatedly deferred quantification of bank guarantee, CAS and expiry-linked revenue to offline follow-ups, which analysts pressed on.
